zh-CN.title: 临淄
zh-CN.subtitle: 先秦诸子交流与齐国都城的区域锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 临淄作为齐国都城和先秦思想交流的城市尺度入口，连接墨家、稷下学术与诸子语境。
curatorialDescription: 地图点位表达历史城市范围，不把诸子活动压缩成一处可精确定位的讲学地点。
zh-CN.researchNote: 稷下学宫与人物活动的具体空间仍需按史传和考古资料拆分。

en.title: Linzi
en.subtitle: A regional anchor for the Qi capital and pre-Qin exchange
en.shortSummary: Linzi provides a city-scale entry into the Qi capital, Jixia learning and the exchange of pre-Qin masters associated with Mozi and related traditions.
curatorialDescription: The map point represents the historical city range and does not reduce masters' activity to one precisely located teaching site.
en.researchNote: The Jixia academy and figure-specific locations require separate historiographical and archaeological review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 战国齐都与诸子交流空间
displayDate.en: Warring States Qi-capital and masters' exchange space

zh-CN.title: 新郑
zh-CN.subtitle: 韩国故都与先秦政治思想的城市锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 新郑是韩国故都的城市尺度入口，用于连接韩非的政治思想与战国制度语境。
curatorialDescription: 城市锚点说明政权与文本语境，不证明人物在城内的具体活动地址。
zh-CN.researchNote: 韩非生平、韩国都城沿革和相关文本需要继续按史传与出土资料核对。

en.title: Xinzheng
en.subtitle: A city anchor for the Han capital and pre-Qin political thought
en.shortSummary: Xinzheng provides a city-scale entry into the Han state capital and the Warring States political context associated with Han Fei.
curatorialDescription: The city anchor expresses political and textual context without claiming a precise address for the figure's activity.
en.researchNote: Han Fei's biography, the capital's historical geography and related texts require further historiographical and archaeological review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 战国韩国都城制度语境
displayDate.en: Warring States Han-capital institutional context

zh-CN.title: 长沙
zh-CN.subtitle: 汉代贾谊与南方政治文化的城市锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 长沙连接贾谊的汉代政治经验、地方治理和文人记忆。
curatorialDescription: 城市尺度定位用于理解贬谪与地方治理语境，不等同于贾谊全部行迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 贾谊在长沙的活动和后世贾谊祠记忆需要按史传与地方文献分层。

en.title: Changsha
en.subtitle: A city anchor for Jia Yi and Han political culture in the south
en.shortSummary: Changsha connects Jia Yi's Han political experience with local governance and later literati memory.
curatorialDescription: The city-scale location frames exile and local governance without standing for Jia Yi's entire itinerary.
en.researchNote: Jia Yi's activity in Changsha and later shrine memory require separate historiographical and local-text layers.

displayDate.zh-CN: 西汉长沙政治与文人记忆空间
displayDate.en: Western Han Changsha political and literati-memory space

zh-CN.title: 永州
zh-CN.subtitle: 中唐文人与地方山水书写的城市锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 永州连接柳宗元的贬谪经历、地方治理和山水文献记忆。
curatorialDescription: 地点表达地方行政与文人书写的共同语境，不把文学文本直接当作每一处实地行迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 柳宗元的具体居所、游历路线和地方遗产点仍需继续拆分。

en.title: Yongzhou
en.subtitle: A city anchor for Tang literati and landscape writing
en.shortSummary: Yongzhou connects Liu Zongyuan's exile, local administration and literary memory of southern landscapes.
curatorialDescription: The place expresses the shared setting of local administration and literati writing without treating literary texts as a complete itinerary.
en.researchNote: Liu Zongyuan's residences, routes and heritage points require further separation.

displayDate.zh-CN: 唐代永州地方治理与山水文献空间
displayDate.en: Tang Yongzhou setting of local governance and landscape writing

zh-CN.title: 金溪
zh-CN.subtitle: 陆九渊心学讲学与地方书院语境
zh-CN.shortSummary: 金溪作为陆九渊活动的地方尺度锚点，连接心学讲学、书院和宋代士人网络。
curatorialDescription: 地点使用县域与城市尺度表达，不把讲学活动定位到未经核实的单一建筑。
zh-CN.researchNote: 象山书院及陆九渊讲学地点需要地方志和遗产资料进一步核定。

en.title: Jinxi
en.subtitle: A local anchor for Lu Jiuyuan's teaching and academy context
en.shortSummary: Jinxi provides a local-scale anchor for Lu Jiuyuan's teaching, academy networks and Southern Song literati culture.
curatorialDescription: The place uses county and city scale and does not assign teaching to one unverified building.
en.researchNote: Xiangshan Academy and Lu Jiuyuan's teaching sites require local-gazetteer and heritage review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 南宋心学讲学与书院空间
displayDate.en: Southern Song mind-learning and academy space

zh-CN.title: 昆山
zh-CN.subtitle: 顾炎武与明清学术地理的地方锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 昆山连接顾炎武的地方经历、经世学术和明清之际的文献网络。
curatorialDescription: 地点表示人物与地方学术记忆的关系，不把后世纪念景观回写成全部生平事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 顾炎武活动路线与昆山地方遗产需要继续按文集、方志和遗址资料拆分。

en.title: Kunshan
en.subtitle: A local anchor for Gu Yanwu and Ming–Qing scholarly geography
en.shortSummary: Kunshan connects Gu Yanwu's local setting with evidential learning and documentary networks at the Ming–Qing transition.
curatorialDescription: The place records a figure–local memory relation without projecting later memorial landscapes into the whole biography.
en.researchNote: Gu Yanwu's routes and Kunshan heritage require further separation through collected writings, gazetteers and site records.

displayDate.zh-CN: 明清之际经世学术地方空间
displayDate.en: Ming–Qing evidential-learning local space

zh-CN.title: 休宁
zh-CN.subtitle: 戴震与清代考据学的地方入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 休宁连接戴震的地方学术背景、音韵训诂和清代考据传统。
curatorialDescription: 县域锚点表达人物地方背景，不代表学术活动只发生在出生地。
zh-CN.researchNote: 戴震生平、书院与学术交游需要继续结合文集和地方资料核实。

en.title: Xiuning
en.subtitle: A local entry for Dai Zhen and Qing evidential scholarship
en.shortSummary: Xiuning connects Dai Zhen's local scholarly background with phonology, philology and Qing evidential learning.
curatorialDescription: The county-scale anchor records local background and does not imply that all scholarship occurred at the birthplace.
en.researchNote: Dai Zhen's biography, academies and scholarly contacts require collected-writings and local-source review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 清代考据学地方学术空间
displayDate.en: Qing evidential-scholarship local setting

zh-CN.title: 绍兴
zh-CN.subtitle: 近代教育与学术转型的地方入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 绍兴为蔡元培的早年地方背景与近代教育、学术机构转型提供城市尺度入口。
curatorialDescription: 地点把现代人物与地方教育史连接起来，不把后来的机构经历回写为清代城市事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 蔡元培早年教育与绍兴地方机构仍需按传记和校史资料细化。

en.title: Shaoxing
en.subtitle: A local entry for modern education and scholarly transformation
en.shortSummary: Shaoxing provides a city-scale entry into Cai Yuanpei's early local setting and the transformation of modern education and academic institutions.
curatorialDescription: The place connects a modern figure with local educational history without projecting later institutions into the Qing city context.
en.researchNote: Cai Yuanpei's early education and Shaoxing institutions require biographical and school-history review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 晚清至民国地方教育与学术空间
displayDate.en: Late Qing–Republican local education and scholarly space

zh-CN.title: 凤翔
zh-CN.subtitle: 张载关学与关中经学地理的地方锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 凤翔连接张载的关中背景、经学讲学和北宋理学早期形成。
curatorialDescription: 地点使用区域城市尺度，呈现关学环境而不指定未经核实的讲学建筑。
zh-CN.researchNote: 张载活动地点与横渠书院遗产需要按地方志、文集与遗址资料继续核对。

en.title: Fengxiang
en.subtitle: A local anchor for Zhang Zai and Guanzhong classical learning
en.shortSummary: Fengxiang connects Zhang Zai's Guanzhong setting with classical teaching and the early formation of Northern Song Neo-Confucian learning.
curatorialDescription: The regional-city scale presents the Guanzhong learning environment without assigning teaching to an unverified building.
en.researchNote: Zhang Zai's activity sites and Hengqu Academy heritage require local, textual and site-level review.

displayDate.zh-CN: 北宋关学与经学讲学空间
displayDate.en: Northern Song Guanzhong space of classical teaching

zh-CN.title: 韩城
zh-CN.subtitle: 司马迁史学记忆与黄河沿岸地方入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 韩城作为司马迁地方记忆与史学传统的城市尺度入口，连接人物、史传与后世纪念。

en.title: Hancheng
en.subtitle: A local entry for Sima Qian's historiographical memory
en.shortSummary: Hancheng provides a city-scale entry into Sima Qian's local memory, historiography and later commemorative landscape.
curatorialDescription: The place records local-memory and birthplace traditions without equating later shrine landscapes with every historical claim.
en.researchNote: The birthplace tradition, shrine heritage and locations of Shiji compilation require separate layers.

displayDate.zh-CN: 西汉史学与地方记忆空间
displayDate.en: Western Han historiographical and local-memory space

zh-CN.title: 上虞
zh-CN.subtitle: 魏伯阳与内丹传统的后世地方记忆入口

curatorialDescription: 该点属于传统与接受层；它可以进入关系和地点档案，不自动成为历史人物轨迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 魏伯阳身份、年代与《参同契》归属仍有学术争议，当前保留保守表述。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 传统东汉道教炼养语境；年代有争议

en.title: Shangyu
en.subtitle: A later-memory entry for Wei Boyang and inner-alchemy tradition
en.shortSummary: Shangyu connects Wei Boyang with the local memory of the Cantong qi tradition without turning hagiographical geography into a recoverable itinerary.
curatorialDescription: This point belongs to tradition and reception layers; it can enter the relation and place dossier but not an automatic historical trajectory.
en.researchNote: Wei Boyang's identity, dates and the attribution of the Cantong qi remain debated; the entry stays deliberately conservative.

displayDate.zh-CN: 传统东汉道教炼养语境；年代有争议
displayDate.en: Traditional Eastern Han Daoist cultivation context; dates contested

zh-CN.title: 南昌
zh-CN.subtitle: 许逊传统与江西道教地方记忆的城市锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 南昌连接许逊、净明传统与江西道教地方记忆，现实城市与仙传层保持分开。

zh-CN.timeLabel: 东晋至后世许逊传统语境

en.title: Nanchang
en.subtitle: A city anchor for Xu Xun tradition and Jiangxi Daoist memory
en.shortSummary: Nanchang connects Xu Xun, the Jingming tradition and local Daoist memory while keeping the modern city separate from hagiographical claims.

en.researchNote: Xu Xun's dates, Jingming formation and local temple heritage require separate biographical and local-source review.

displayDate.en: Eastern Jin to later Xu Xun Daoist-memory context

zh-CN.shortSummary: 北京连接丘处机的北方道教活动、宫观制度和后世全真传统。

zh-CN.timeLabel: 金元至清代道教制度语境

en.title: Beijing
en.subtitle: A northern anchor for Daoist institutions from the Jin–Yuan to Qing periods
en.shortSummary: Beijing connects Qiu Chuji's northern Daoist activity with institutional and later Quanzhen networks.
curatorialDescription: The city-scale place expresses an institutional network and does not reduce activity to one surviving building.

zh-CN.title: 宁海

zh-CN.researchNote: 宁海全真遗产、人物活动阶段与宫观沿革需要继续按传记和碑刻核实。

en.title: Ninghai
en.subtitle: A local anchor for early Quanzhen figures and the Jiaodong Daoist network
en.shortSummary: Ninghai connects Ma Danyang, Sun Bu'er, Liu Chuxuan and the early Quanzhen temple network.

zh-CN.title: 成都

en.title: Chengdu
en.subtitle: A city entry for Daoist texts and mountain networks from the late Tang to Qing
en.shortSummary: Chengdu connects Du Guangting, Liu Yiming and southwestern textual, temple and mountain networks.
curatorialDescription: The city point expresses a regional network and does not reduce cultivation or writing to one coordinate.

zh-CN.shortSummary: 姑臧连接昙无谶译经、北凉政权和河西走廊佛教文本网络。

en.subtitle: A historical-city anchor for Northern Liang translation and the Hexi corridor

zh-CN.title: 广州
zh-CN.subtitle: 海上交通与南方佛教传播的城市锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 广州作为南方港口城市入口，连接印度洋交通、佛教传入与岭南城市网络。

en.title: Guangzhou
en.subtitle: A city anchor for maritime exchange and southern Buddhist transmission
en.shortSummary: Guangzhou provides a southern port entry into Indian Ocean exchange, Buddhist transmission and Lingnan urban networks.

zh-CN.title: 南岳
zh-CN.subtitle: 慧思与天台教观形成的山岳锚点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 南岳连接慧思的山岳修学、天台教观形成与南北朝佛教网络。

en.title: Huangmei
en.subtitle: A city anchor for Chan transmission and eastern Hubei memory
en.shortSummary: Huangmei connects Huineng traditions, Chan ancestral-site memory and eastern Hubei transport networks.
curatorialDescription: The place preserves transmission and later-memory layers without projecting school genealogies into one historical scene.

zh-CN.title: 杭州
